**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

§ 22 (Audit Rights) is the only audit/verification right binding Northwind, and it satisfies the playbook's **preferred** position on all material terms:

| Element | Preferred | § 22 |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | Max once / 12 months | Once in any twelve-month period ✔ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | At least thirty days' prior written ✔ |
| Timing/conduct | Business hours | Normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✔ |
| Auditor | Independent, confidentiality-bound | Same, off-site where practicable ✔ |
| Cost | Vendor's, unless underpayment >5% | Identical ✔ |
| System access | None | No direct system access, no unrelated Customer Data, privileged or third-party material ✔ |

§ 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of final report, payment of shortfall resolves the issue). § 23 holds no counterparty audit right, and a document-wide search found no other inspection, verification or remote-monitoring rights against us.
